description: Origine de l'électricité fournie par EDF SA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EDF SA. Résumé: Depuis le 1er juillet 2004, le décret d’application de la directive européenne 2003/54/CE du 26/06/03 fait obligation aux fournisseurs d’électricité, d’indiquer à tous leurs clients la répartition entre les différentes sources d'énergie utilisées pour fournir l'électricité et le contenu en CO2 et en déchets radioactifs du kilowattheure fourni. Coverage: EDF SA. The publisher named on the listing is EDF SA. Its keywords include thermique-a-flamme, mix-de-production, nucleaire, hydraulique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in URL. The listing shows 2025-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
